notes.title: Hunger Apartment “Unusual EA” Announcement
notes.content:
Hi, Forks: 

Hunger Apartment is a special game for you, and also a bold attempt for us. We have an eager wish to do something different. We are an independent team so the environment and process for developing this game are not easy. We don't want to commercialize the product at all, even knowing that under such circumstances, the game may be in a state of non-profit, which makes us unable to survive. This game is the last attempt for us before the team faces the biggest crisis, we squeeze out the time and this is the last chance we had.

As you can see, the game only has EP1-EP2, which is very short. Even so, we spent a lot of time on the optimization of this version. The operation of the game and the content hidden in the details, so we tried to add a lot of hints to make sure the game is not particularly difficult and at the same time, you can experience this one hour of content smoothly. 
Why is there no more content in the game? 
Because before this game gets enough support, our economic situation can't support the next content. We expect the full content of the game to reach EP10, and we hope to be able to continue. 

At first, we hope to adopt the form of EA, but for our current situation, we can't support the promotion cost of EA stage, so we have no choice but to choose the official release to achieve the maximum Steam exposure, but this does not mean that we really think this is a complete game, we will still accept the player's opinion in the way of EA.

The game is about to be released soon, and we are very nervous cause it seems that this moment can decide whether the game can continue to do it... To be optimistic, if we got enough support, we will make EP3-4 and EP5-6 ASAP, and launch it in the form of the DLC. Of course, DLC will somehow thank the players for their support.

The setting of the game itself is fantastic. We want to explore humanity, a lot of content is being hidden, such as witchcraft, it also has different timelines and social phenomena. We hope that you could participate in the discussion of the game and help us to do better. .

Thank you

Hunger Apartment development team
March 19, 2019
